## Origin

- [ ] Written by a person
- [ ] Drafted by AI (entries stay `draft` with `origin: ai-draft` until reviewed)

## Checklist (author)

- [ ] Every new fact has a source in the entry's `sources` (no Wikipedia-only facts for genera)
- [ ] Own words — no copied sentences
- [ ] Images: licence allowed (CC0 / PD / CC BY / CC BY-SA), correct taxon, added with `scripts/media.py push`
- [ ] `python3 scripts/fmt.py`, `build.py` and `validate.py` run (0 errors)
- [ ] Nothing marked `checked` by its own author

## For the reviewer

- [ ] I checked the changes against the cited sources
- [ ] I did not write or co-write this change
- [ ] Classification, synonymy or `checked` promotions: a **second** reviewer has approved too
